title: Identity detail pages and Identity Search in Identity Protection: AD user, Entra ID identity, Okta enrichment and cross-platform search

prose.label: Identity Search.
prose.text: {{identity-search-prerequisites}} {{identity-search-enrichment}} {{identity-search-filters}} {{identity-search-recent-changes}} {{identity-search-credentials}} Retention of ITDR or posture-scan data is not stated {{gap:posture-data-retention}}.

checks.do: Whether ITDR is integrated with Okta when an Okta tile on the AD user page shows No Data.
Whether ZIA and ZPA access snapshots rely on SCIM user provisioning and authentication method.

ad-user-password-reuse.statement: The AD user Summary tab shows Password Reuse Detected as the number of other AD accounts sharing the affected user's password, excluding the affected user.

quotes: Password Reuse Detected: The total number of other AD user accounts that share the same password as the affected AD user. This count excludes the affected AD user.
evidence.after: Provides a snapshot of identity vulnerabilities in the AD user account. On the Summary page, you can do the following:

okta-enrichment.statement: To view Okta account details on the AD user page, ITDR must be integrated with Okta and the user must exist in Okta; if the user does not exist in Okta, the Okta tile shows No Data.

quotes: View the following Okta user account details, if the user exists in Okta.
To view the Okta user accounts details, ensure that ITDR is integrated with Okta. If the user doesn't exist in Okta, the Okta tile shows No Data.

okta-actions.statement: The Actions menu on the AD user page offers Contain with ZPA, Contain with ZIA, Suspend, Unsuspend, Activate, Deactivate, Reset Password, Clear User Sessions and Reset Authenticators; Deactivate removes access to apps authenticated via Okta.

quotes: Select any of these options from the Actions drop-down menu:
Contain with ZPA
Contain with ZIA
Suspend the Okta user account and disable user access.
Activate the deactivated Okta user account.
Reset Password
Reset password of the Okta user account.
Unsuspend the suspended Okta user account and enable user access.
Deactivate the Okta user account and temporarily disable user access until activated again. This removes access to all the apps that were previously authenticated via Okta.
Clear User Sessions
Clear all active sessions of the user.
Reset Authenticators
Reset the authenticators.

okta-log-retention.statement: Okta system logs shown for threat detection are retained for 14 days and then permanently deleted; the retention period cannot be modified.

quotes: These logs are only retained for 14 days, after which they are permanently deleted. You cannot modify the retention period.

threatparse.statement: ThreatParse is a technology built into ITDR that reconstructs attacks in natural language by translating log information into plain English, linking it to MITRE ATT&CK and including risk scores assigned to attackers.

quotes: ThreatParse is a technology built into ITDR that conducts natural language reconstruction of attacks by summarizing and translating log information into plain English.
It also links this information to the MITRE ATT&CK framework and includes the risk scores assigned to attackers.

access-risk-scim.statement: The ITDR integration with ZIA and ZPA works with SCIM user provisioning and authentication method only.

quotes: ITDR integration with ZIA and ZPA services works with SCIM user provisioning and authentication method only.

session-tracking.statement: Session tracking can be enabled in the server agent policy to monitor logon activities for all AD administrators and privileged accounts.

quotes: You can enable session tracking in the server agent policy to monitor logon activities for all AD administrators and privileged accounts.

okta-event-values.statement: Okta event severity is Debug, Info, Error or Warn, and event result is Allow, Challenge, Deny, Failure, Skipped, Success or Unknown.

quotes: Severity: The severity (Debug, Info, Error, and Warn) of the event.
Result: The result (Allow, Challenge, Deny, Failure, Skipped, Success, and Unknown) of an action in the event.
evidence.after: Click Export CSV to export these Okta activity log details as a CSV file.

entra-identity-mfa.statement: The Entra ID identity details page shows MFA status as Is Capable, Is Registered, Methods Registered and Default Method; the last two show no data if MFA methods are not configured.

quotes: Is Capable: Indicates if the identity is capable of using MFA.
Is Registered: Indicates if the identity is registered for MFA.
If the MFA authentication methods are not configured, the Methods Registered and Default Method fields don't display any data.

entra-identity-fields.statement: The Entra ID identity details page shows User Type (Member or Guest), a View Roles link to Entra roles and Azure RBAC built-in or custom roles, and on-premises AD details including Security Identifier and Sync Enabled.

quotes: User Type: The Entra ID user type (Member or Guest).
Click View Roles to view the details of the Entra roles and Azure RBAC built-in or custom roles that are assigned to the identity.
Security Identifier: The security identifier (SID) details of the on-premises AD account.
Sync Enabled: Indicates if the on-premises AD account is synced with Azure Entra ID.

entra-change-impact-and-raw.statement: The Entra ID identity details page shows Change Data, the details of a detected change such as the operation name, caller IP address, data source information and role details.

quotes: Change Data: The details of the change that was detected in the identity, such as the operation name, the caller IP address, data source information, and role details.

identity-search-prerequisites.statement: Identity Search requires an AD or Entra ID posture scan with attribute collection enabled; Okta integration is required to correlate Okta identities.

quotes: To use the Identity Search feature, you must run an AD or Entra ID posture scan with attribute collection enabled.
Integrate ITDR with Okta. This is required to correlate identities in Okta.

identity-search-enrichment.statement: Identity Search is enriched by an endpoint credential exposure scan and by a threat detection policy.

quotes: Run an endpoint credential exposure scan to enrich identity information with the state of stored credentials and flag any risky credentials or settings.
Configure a threat detection policy to enrich identity information with threat events recorded for a given identity.

identity-search-filters.statement: Identity Search searches AD, Entra ID and Okta identities and filters by AD, Entra ID, Okta, Is Privileged, MFA not enabled and Credential Issues; results download as CSV or JSON.

quotes: Search for an identity across various identity platforms (AD, Entra ID, and Okta).
download the details as a CSV or JSON file
AD, Entra ID, and Okta
Is Privileged
MFA not enabled
Credential Issues

identity-search-recent-changes.statement: The Identity Search identity details show Recent Changes as the total number of recent active changes detected in the last 7 days.

quotes: Recent Changes: The total number of recent active changes detected in the last 7 days.

identity-search-credentials.statement: The Identity Search identity details list exposed endpoint credentials for AD identities, and a Severity field takes the values Critical or High.

quotes: exposed endpoint credentials (for AD identities)
Severity: Severity level (Critical or High).

posture-data-retention.title: How long ITDR or posture-scan data is retained
posture-data-retention.detail: The AD user details page states a 14-day retention for Okta system logs, but these articles do not state retention for ITDR or posture-scan data.
